items.title: Mean Green Defeats Rice, 52-23
items.summary: Jahiem White had 141 yards rushing and three touchdowns, Tayven Jackson threw a touchdown pass and scored on a 6-yard run and North Texas beat Rice 52-24 on Saturday for the Mean Green's sixth consecutive win.

items.title: Mean Green Welcoming Rice for Homecoming Game
items.summary: DENTON – The UNT football team returns to action on Saturday, as the Mean Green host Rice for Homecoming with kickoff set for 3 p.m. The game will be televised on ESPNU, with the radio broadcast set for 1190 AM/The Varsity Network.

items.title: Jackson Named Earl Campbell Tyler Rose POTW
items.summary: TYLER, Texas – Fifth-year quarterback Tayven Jackson added to his growing list of accolades on Tuesday when he was named the Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award Player of the Week after his standout performance in Thursday's 48-41 win over Florida Atlantic.

items.title: White Named to Comeback Player of the Year List
items.summary: NEW YORK — North Texas senior running back Jahiem White was named on Monday to the Midseason Watch List for the 2026 Comeback Player of the Year Award by College Sports Communicators, in association with The Associated Press.

items.title: Jackson Put On Davey O'Brien Midseason Watch List
items.summary: FORT WORTH — North Texas quarterback Tayven Jackson was selected to the Davey O'Brien Award Great 8 for Week 9 on Monday following his standout performance in Thursday night's win over Florida Atlantic.

items.title: Mean Green Move to 4-0 in American Play
items.summary: DENTON — The Mean Green offense once again showed why they are one of the most lethal units in the nation, and UNT moved to 4-0 in conference play for the first time since it was a Sun Belt program in 2004, with a 48-41 shootout over Florida Atlantic on Thursday night.

items.title: Stevenson Added to Biletnikoff Watch List
items.summary: DENTON — Senior wide receiver Justin Stevenson was added to the 2026 Biletnikoff Award Watch List on Wednesday, as part of the fourth in-season addition to the watch list.

items.title: UNT to Host ESPN’s ‘SportsCenter on Campus’ Before Nationally Televised Game vs. FAU
items.summary: DENTON, Texas – UNT Athletics is set to host ESPN's 'SportsCenter on Campus' on Thursday, Oct. 29, prior to its nationally televised football game against Florida Atlantic.
